coverage.summary: Rental units in the City of Los Angeles subject to the RSO: rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28.
coverage.other_conditions: Property must be located in the City of Los Angeles and subject to the RSO. Replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are covered regardless of construction date.

result.notes: Three corrections were made. (1) requires_unknown_facts changed from true to false. The RSO covers ordinary rental buildings identified by construction date, which is expressed through construction_cutoff. The luxury and temporary exemptions are applied-for exemptions that an address lookup cannot check, so they belong in unverifiable_exemptions, now split into separate items. (2) supersedes_state_rule changed from false to null. No document states how this rule relates to Civ. Code 1950.5. (3) other_conditions now also notes replacement units under LAMC 151.28. These can postdate 1978, so the construction cutoff alone will miss them. The construction_cutoff basis stays year_built, the closest available enum to LAHD's 'first built' language.
